name: Connors R3 RSI(2) three-day-decline with deep oversold
author: Pine port of Larry Connors R3 (R3 ETF Strategy)
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
entry_long: close > EMA(200); RSI(2) has fallen three days in a row (RSI<RSI[1]<RSI[2]<RSI[3]); RSI 3 bars ago < 60; today RSI(2) < 10.
exit: Close long when RSI(2) crosses up through 70.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
implementation_notes: Defaults 60/10/70 are the script inputs; matches Connors "R3" concept (RSI(2) decline three days, first day under 60, drop under 10).
